cover_headline: Sethuraman Panchanathan, First Indian American to Win Engineering's Bueche Award
facts: First Indian American — and first Arizonan — to win the Bueche Award in its more than 40-year history
Served as the 15th director of the National Science Foundation from 2020 to 2025
India conferred the Padma Shri on him on May 27, 2025 — top honours from both countries in consecutive years

quote.text: The rocks were just rocks. But what fascinated me was all the human ingenuity and scientific prowess that went into bringing them here.
quote.speaker: Sethuraman Panchanathan

end.headline: Who Is Sethuraman Panchanathan? The Chennai-Born Scientist Who Ran the NSF — and Just Became the First Indian American to Win Engineering's Bueche Award
end.line: The Chennai-born scientist who ran the NSF has received the National Academy of Engineering's highest policy honour — an award no Indian American had won in its 43 years.
